adminWorkflows.title: Workflows
adminWorkflows.subtitle: Design how each service request moves through approvals, tasks and notifications. Publishing creates a new version; requests already in progress keep the version they started on.
adminWorkflows.emptyBody: Create a workflow to route requests to the right people.
adminWorkflows.newBody: It starts with a start and an end step. Add steps in the builder, then publish when it is ready.
adminWorkflows.noServicesLong: Not linked to a service yet. Link it from the service settings to start using it.
adminWorkflows.inFlight: {count, plural, one {# in progress} other {# in progress}}
adminWorkflows.versionsHint: Versions never change once published. Requests in progress finish on the version they started with.
adminWorkflows.aiOff: AI features are turned off for this school.
adminWorkflows.revertHint: Discard the draft and go back to the live version
adminWorkflows.revertNoVersion: There is no published version to go back to yet.
adminWorkflows.revertNothing: The canvas already matches the live version.
adminWorkflows.revertTitle: Go back to the live version?
adminWorkflows.revertBody: Your draft changes will be discarded and the canvas will show version {version} again.
adminWorkflows.saveHint: Save your changes without publishing them
adminWorkflows.publishBlocked: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem before publishing} other {Fix # problems before publishing}}
adminWorkflows.nothingToPublish: This is already the live version
adminWorkflows.publishBody: New requests will follow this version from now on.
adminWorkflows.publishServices: {count, plural, one {The linked service starts new requests on this version.} other {The # linked services start new requests on this version.}}
adminWorkflows.publishNoServices: No service uses this workflow yet, so nothing changes for families or staff.
adminWorkflows.publishInFlight: {count, plural, one {# request in progress keeps running on its current version.} other {# requests in progress keep running on their current versions.}}
adminWorkflows.publishNoInFlight: No requests are in progress on older versions.
adminWorkflows.publishSavesDraft: Your unsaved changes are saved as part of publishing.
adminWorkflows.sgBody: A safeguarding service uses this workflow. The case must stay restricted and every approval, assignment and task must route to the Designated Safeguarding Lead team. Families are never notified automatically. Publishing is blocked until these rules hold.
adminWorkflows.aiBannerBody: Check every step before you save. Nothing is live until you publish.
adminWorkflows.aiBannerBuiltIn: Drafted by the built-in assistant from your keywords. Check every step before you save. Nothing is live until you publish.
adminWorkflows.aiBody: Describe who needs to approve, what should happen and who should be told. The draft replaces the canvas so you can review it.
adminWorkflows.aiPlaceholder: For example: parent consent, then the homeroom teacher, then the principal signs off and a letter is issued.
adminWorkflows.aiExample1: Parent consent, then the principal approves and a letter is issued
adminWorkflows.aiExample2: Teacher approval, then head of department, then the registrar
adminWorkflows.aiExample3: Laptop repair handled by IT support, tell the requester when done
adminWorkflows.aiNote: The draft is checked by the validator and never published automatically. Your saved draft is untouched until you save.
adminWorkflows.aiLoaded: Draft loaded. Review it before saving.
adminWorkflows.paletteHint: Click a step to add it to the canvas, then drag from its bottom dot to connect it.
adminWorkflows.selectStep: Select a step to edit it
adminWorkflows.selectStepBody: Click a step on the canvas, or press Tab to move between steps and Enter to select one.
adminWorkflows.helpConnect: Drag from the dot at the bottom of a step to the top of another to connect them.
adminWorkflows.helpBranches: Approvals and conditions have two exits: approved or rejected, yes or no.
adminWorkflows.keyboardHint: Press Delete or Backspace to remove the selected step or connection.
adminWorkflows.startLocked: Every workflow needs its start step.
adminWorkflows.subjectFieldHint: Optional. The form field that holds the subject, such as fromSubject.
adminWorkflows.departmentFromForm: Department of the subject on the form
adminWorkflows.blockingHint: The request only moves on once this task is marked done.
adminWorkflows.familyGuard: For wellbeing and safeguarding requests, students and families are skipped automatically. Staff decide when to contact them.
adminWorkflows.conditionFieldHint: Use form.fieldKey for form answers, or request.hasStudent, request.priority, student.grade.
adminWorkflows.conditionValueHint: Type true or false for yes or no answers.
adminWorkflows.compoundReadOnly: This step combines several conditions. It runs as designed but can only be changed by rebuilding it here as simple checks.
adminWorkflows.validBody: All checks pass: one start, a reachable end, every step configured and every branch connected.
adminWorkflows.validBodySg: All checks pass, including safeguarding routing to the DSL team.

rules.end: At least one end step that can be reached
rules.edges: No broken, duplicate or looping connections
rules.config: Every step has its names and settings
rules.branches: Approvals and conditions have both exits connected
rules.safeguarding: Safeguarding: restricted case, DSL routing, no automatic family messages

adminWorkflows.simIntro: Walk through the workflow with sample outcomes. Nothing is saved and nobody is notified.
adminWorkflows.simStuck: The path stops before reaching an end step.

typeHints.start: Runs when a request is submitted
typeHints.approval: Waits for one or more people to decide
typeHints.notify: Sends a message from a template
typeHints.condition: Chooses a branch based on the request
typeHints.create_case: Opens a case for the student
typeHints.schedule_meeting: Asks someone to book a meeting
typeHints.generate_document: Creates a letter from a template
typeHints.ai_summary: Prepares a brief for staff to review

modeHints.SEQUENTIAL: Each approver is asked in order. A rejection stops the chain.
modeHints.PARALLEL_ALL: All approvers are asked at once and all must approve.
modeHints.PARALLEL_ANY: All approvers are asked at once. The first decision counts.

issues.multiple_start: "{step}" is a second start step. Keep only one.
issues.end_unreachable: No end step can be reached from the start.
issues.unreachable: "{step}" can never run. Connect it to the flow.
issues.dead_end: "{step}" leads nowhere. Connect it to a next step.
issues.start_incoming: Nothing can lead back into the start step.
issues.end_outgoing: "{step}" is an end step and cannot continue.
issues.dangling_edge: A connection points to a step that no longer exists.
issues.cycle: "{step}" is part of a loop. Each step runs once per request.
issues.bad_handle: A connection from "{step}" uses the wrong exit.
issues.missing_label: "{step}" needs a name in English and Arabic.
issues.missing_title: "{step}" needs a task title in English and Arabic.
issues.missing_recipients: "{step}" needs at least one complete recipient.
issues.missing_condition: "{step}" needs a field and a comparison.
issues.missing_value: "{step}" needs a value to compare with.
issues.missing_hours: "{step}" needs a wait longer than zero.
issues.approver_incomplete: "{step}" has an approver without a person or name.
issues.sg_no_case: Safeguarding workflows must open a restricted safeguarding case.
issues.sg_case_not_restricted: "{step}" must open a Safeguarding case with Safeguarding sensitivity.
issues.sg_routing: "{step}" must route to the Designated Safeguarding Lead, the deputy or the case owner.
issues.sg_family_notified: "{step}" must not message the student or family. Staff decide when to contact them.
